name: jonaslejon
description: Linux security auditing for Claude Code

plugins.name: linux-security-audit
plugins.description: Audit a Linux host's security hardening posture and produce a risk-ranked report. 460 checks across 33 areas: kernel sysctls and boot parameters, mount options, SUID/SGID, SELinux/AppArmor confinement, local privilege-escalation paths, the boot and service-start trust chain, TLS ciphers and mutual-TLS enforcement, web server hardening, cleartext secrets, image and template hygiene, and static-vs-runtime drift. Runs against a live host, a mounted image, or a container.
